description:
Cisco Intersight is a cloud operations platform that consists of optional, modular capabilities of advanced infrastructure, workload optimization, and Kubernetes services. Cisco Intersight infrastructure services include the deployment, monitoring, management, and support of your physical and virtual infrastructure.

Cisco Intersight   is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) infrastructure management platform that is augmented by other intelligent systems. It provides secure, lifecycle management of Cisco Unified Computing System   (UCS), HyperFlex   and third-party devices.

Cisco Intersight lets you control everything from servers to containers, apps, and infrastructure from a single platform.

labeler_proposal.rationale: The text describes infrastructure deployment, monitoring, lifecycle management, and control; its reference to augmentation by intelligent systems does not specify AI functionality, leaving ambiguity.
evidence_spans: It provides secure, lifecycle management of Cisco Unified Computing System   (UCS), HyperFlex   and third-party devices.
augmented by other intelligent systems

control everything from servers to containers, apps, and infrastructure

parent_concern: Resolve differing support flags for conventional infrastructure management augmented by unspecified 'intelligent systems'. Do not infer what those systems implement.
